name: Miniature City Disaster BTS
description: Generate viral BTS-style miniature city disaster videos like @wonderfulworldai. Shows film crew shooting practical effects of a scale model city being destroyed by tsunami/disaster in a water tank studio.

data.comment:
# 🎬 Miniature City Disaster BTS v3

**@wonderfulworldai** style (18M+ likes)

**CRITICAL for starting image:**
- Studio/crew = FOREGROUND (большая часть кадра)
- Miniature = BACKGROUND (далеко, мелко)
- Water = CALM (волны нет!)
- Lighting = BRIGHT

**The video model will animate:**
- Wave forming and growing
- Destruction of the miniature
- Crew reactions

data.description: Type of disaster: tsunami wave, tornado, meteor impact

data.prompt:
Wide shot of a brightly lit Hollywood special effects studio. Behind-the-scenes setup photo BEFORE the action starts.

TOP HALF OF FRAME - BACKGROUND:
A massive bright blue chroma key screen fills the entire back wall, covered with a grid of orange and red tracking marker crosses. Very bright studio lighting from multiple large film lights on ceiling rigging. The blue screen is the dominant visual element.

MIDDLE OF FRAME - FAR AWAY:
A large indoor water tank built into the studio floor. The water is COMPLETELY CALM and STILL - no waves, no ripples, like a swimming pool. In the DISTANCE inside the tank: a small miniature scale model of {{ city }} - tiny buildings, a miniature pier with ferris wheel, barely visible because it's far away.

BOTTOM HALF OF FRAME - FOREGROUND (most important!):
Professional film crew of 5-6 people positioned along the edge of the water tank. They wear matching black t-shirts with 'EFFECTS CREW' in white text on their backs. Camera operators crouching with professional cinema cameras. Dolly track rails visible on the ground. Equipment monitors. A large camera crane/jib arm extending over the water.

This is the CALM BEFORE THE STORM - the crew is ready, waiting for the wave machine to activate. Anticipation moment. No action yet.

Shot from elevated angle looking down at the entire studio set. Very bright, well-lit, professional film production environment. Photorealistic behind-the-scenes documentary photograph.

data.negative_prompt: wave, waves, tsunami, water splash, destruction, action, dark, moody, night, dramatic lighting, close-up of miniature, miniature filling the frame, no people, empty studio, cartoon, anime

data.prompt:
Animate this calm studio setup photo into a dramatic 15-second destruction sequence.

PHASE 1 (0-3 sec): ANTICIPATION. The calm before the storm. Slight camera movement. Crew members making final adjustments. The water is still. Building tension.

PHASE 2 (3-6 sec): THE WAVE BEGINS. Suddenly, the wave machine activates. A {{ disaster }} starts forming at the far end of the tank. The water rises dramatically. Crew members turn to watch. Camera operators begin tracking.

PHASE 3 (6-11 sec): DESTRUCTION. The massive wave crashes into the miniature {{ city }}. Spectacular chaos: buildings topple, water explodes everywhere, the ferris wheel falls, debris flies. The crew keeps filming as water splashes toward them. Slow-motion feel during peak destruction.

PHASE 4 (11-15 sec): AFTERMATH. Water continues flooding through the destroyed miniature. Crew members excited by the successful shot. Camera crane sweeps over the flooded city from above.

Maintain the BTS perspective throughout - crew always visible in frame. Bright studio lighting. Professional filmmaking atmosphere.
